description: Powertrain data for battery management, etc.
Engine-specific data, stopping at the bell housing.
Signals related to the engine oil
Signals related to the engine coolant
Signals related to Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF). DEF is called AUS32 in ISO 22241.
comment: In retail and marketing other names are typically used for the fluid.

description: Transmission-specific data, stopping at the drive shafts.
Signals related to the engine coolant (if applicable).
Temperature Information for the battery pack.
Voltage information for cells in the battery pack.
Information on the state of charge of the vehicle's high voltage battery.
Properties related to a particular charging port available in the vehicle.
comment: If a vehicle has a single charging port, then use the instance AnyPosition.

description: Maximum charging current that can be accepted by the system, as measured at the charging inlet.
Current charging voltage, as measured at the charging inlet.
Location of last or current charging event.
comment: This may depending on implementation represent the location of (the charge port of) the vehicle during charging, or the actual location of the charger/load connected to the vehicle.

description: Properties related to timing of battery charging sessions.
Properties related to DC/DC converter converting high voltage (from high voltage battery) to vehicle low voltage (supply voltage, typically 12 Volts).
Properties related to preparing the vehicle battery for charging or driving.
Hood status. Start position for Hood is Closed.
comment: The hood is the hinged cover over the engine compartment of a motor vehicles. Depending on vehicle, it can be either in the front or back of the vehicle. Luggage compartments are in VSS called trunks, even if they are located at the front of the vehicle.

description: Trunk status. Start position for Trunk is Closed.
comment: A trunk is a luggage compartment in a vehicle. Depending on vehicle, it can be either in the front or back of the vehicle. Some vehicles may have trunks both at the front and at the rear of the vehicle.

description: Signals to control behavior of wipers in detail. By default VSS expects only one instance.
comment: These signals are typically not directly available to the user/driver of the vehicle. The overlay in overlays/extensions/dual_wiper_systems.vspec can be used to modify this branch to support two instances; Primary and Secondary.

description: Rear window shade. Open = Retracted, Closed = Deployed. Start position for RearShade is Open/Retracted.
HVAC for single station in the vehicle
Collection of signals updated in concert when a new media is played

comment: Smartphone projection exposes or controls specific applications on the Smartphone on the vehicle infotainment system.
Smartphone screen mirroring mirrors the whole screen of the Smartphone on the vehicle infotainment system.

description: Sun roof shade status. Open = Retracted, Closed = Deployed. Start position for Sunroof.Shade is Open/Retracted.
Light that is part of the Cabin.
comment: V4.0 branch renamed from "Lights" to "Light" to comply with singular naming of entities. Use SingleConfigurableLight.vspec to describe interior lights that can be configured.

description: Spotlight for a specific area in the vehicle.
Decorative coloured light inside the cabin, usually mounted on the door, ceiling, etc.
Decorative coloured light bar that supports effects, usually mounted on the dashboard (e.g. BMW i7 Interactive bar).
All doors, including windows and switches.
Door window status. Start position for Window is Closed.
Side window shade. Open = Retracted, Closed = Deployed. Start position for Shade is Open/Retracted.
Describes signals related to the backrest of the seat.
Adjustable lumbar support mechanisms in seats allow the user to change the seat back shape.
Backrest side bolster (lumbar side support) settings.
Describes signals related to the seat bottom of the seat.
comment: Seating is here considered as the part of the seat that supports the thighs. Additional cushions (if any) for support of lower legs is not covered by this branch.

description: Describes switches related to the backrest of the seat.
Describes switches related to the seating of the seat.
All Advanced Driver Assist Systems data.
Signals from Lane Departure Detection System.
Road friction values reported by the ESC system.
All data concerning steering, suspension, wheels, and brakes.
Wide range/band oxygen sensors (PID 24 - 2B and PID 34 - 3B)
PID 41 - OBD status for the current drive cycle
The current position of the driver head on vehicle axis according to ISO 23150:2023.
Direction from mid eye position to object driver is looking at.
Information about exterior measured by vehicle.
Signals related to low voltage battery.
Spatial acceleration. Axis definitions according to ISO 8855.
Spatial rotation. Axis definitions according to ISO 8855.
The current latitude and longitude of the vehicle.
Information on the GNSS receiver used for determining current location.
Mounting position of GNSS receiver antenna relative to vehicle coordinate system. Axis definitions according to ISO 8855. Origin at center of (first) rear axle.
